answer: Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. The design leans on random re-execution by unrelated peers, released only after three unrelated confirmations. The glacier lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the river is where a second reviewer recomputes them. By the nadir of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work.
